Terms of Engagement

Effective Date: January 2026

1. The Agreement

By engaging The Burujan for IT services, you agree to these terms. We are not just vendors; we are your technical partners, and this document defines the structure of our partnership.

2. Scope of Services

We provide:

  • Web Architecture (Led by Rao Abdul Hadi)
  • App Ecosystems (Led by Rana Talha Jabbar)
  • Full Stack Solutions (Led by Muhammad Hafeez)
  • DevOps & Infrastructure (Led by Muhammad Huzaifa Hassan)

3. Payments & Milestones

Unless agreed otherwise in a specific contract:

  • 50% Deposit is required to commence the "Architecture/Design" phase.
  • 50% Balance is due upon final deployment/handover.
  • Late payments may incur a pause in services or server suspension.

4. Intellectual Property (IP)

Upon full payment, the client owns the source code and design assets. The Burujan retains the right to use the project in our portfolio ("The Structural Proofs") unless a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is signed.

5. Limitation of Liability

While we engineer for stability, The Burujan is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or data loss caused by third-party failures (e.g., AWS outages, ISP failures) or client mismanagement of the codebase after handover.

6. Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Faisalabad, Punjab.
